description: Run an interactive Python app in this project. AX Code selects the environment and an available port.
setup.uv: Prepare this project’s local Python environment using uv.lock, then run the app. Packages may be downloaded. The lockfile will not be changed.
setup.requirements: Install requirements.txt into this project’s local Python environment, then run the app. Packages may be downloaded.
setup.simple: Create or reuse a local Python environment in this project and install Streamlit 1.66.0, then run the app. Other dependencies must be declared by the project.
error.python: Python 3.11 or newer is required. Install Python or select a compatible interpreter under Advanced options.
error.file: The app file was not found inside this project. Choose its Python entry file.
error.config: The project has invalid Python or Streamlit configuration. Check its TOML files and the terminal output.
error.uv: This project uses uv.lock. Install uv, then run again with the project environment.
error.unsupported: This environment needs the project’s own setup procedure. Ask AX Code to prepare the project dependencies, then run again.
error.environment: The local Python environment could not be prepared. Check the action’s terminal output; existing environments have not been deleted.
error.install: Dependency setup failed. Check the terminal output and the project’s dependency files, then try again.
error.dependency: The prepared environment does not contain Streamlit. Add Streamlit to the project dependencies, then prepare again.
error.port: The selected port is unavailable. Leave the port blank under Advanced options to select one automatically.
